calibration.plateau: c_p x (1 +/- 10 %) is reported, never selected
calibration.rule: solve c_p so mean(min(1, c/sigma20**p)) = mean(min(1, 0.35/sigma20)) over the finite-sigma sessions; p = 1 fixed to 0.35

params.gate_set: ewma_band_v1 G1-G9 vs K; after tax: 3 windows at $100k + B1/B2 (median >= 0, share > 0 >= 55 %)
params.multiple_testing: 4 exponent arms, no searched parameter; the +/-10 % c_p rows are report-only
params.non_inferiority_tier: realised mean-weight drift <= 1.0 pp => the pre-tax reading is non-inferiority (G5 median >= -0.05 pp both models, G9 <= 2x K); reported, never adoptable

E2.verdict: reject (tier-N non-inferior; strict set fails: G7,G8)
